scenes.narration: Deep beneath Earth's crust lies molten rock called magma. When pressure builds up it can force its way upward.
scenes.prompt: Cross section of Earth showing a glowing orange magma chamber beneath gray crust, simple cartoon style, soft lighting
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom in toward the magma chamber

scenes.narration: As it rises through the crust the magma heats surrounding rock and can melt more material along its path.
scenes.prompt: Vertical column of bright orange magma moving upward through layered gray rock, gentle heat haze effect
scenes.motion_direction: pan up following the rising magma

scenes.narration: When pressure becomes too great it erupts, spewing lava ash and gas into the air.
scenes.prompt: Explosive volcano with red lava flowing down slopes, dark gray ash plume rising, dramatic lighting
scenes.motion_direction: quick pan right to follow the lava flow

scenes.narration: Eruptions reshape landscapes and create new land. Understanding them helps keep communities safe.
scenes.prompt: Cooling lava solidifying into black rock, green plants beginning to grow over it, sunrise lighting
scenes.motion_direction: slow zoom out showing the whole scene
